name: Red Cat Holdings (RCAT)
teaser: Watchlist for new money. The price is 13.6% above the Base value. Red Cat is spending most of its cash on Steyr Motors before its second-half drone ramp has shown up, and it will likely need new shares in 2027. Confidence D requires a 55% margin of safety, so the buy zone starts at $1.58.
llms: Pre-profit U.S. military drone and uncrewed boat maker (Black Widow, Blue Ops) buying Austrian engine maker Steyr Motors for about $230 million in cash, valued on a scenario path to 2029 operating profit with cash burn, new shares and dilution. Bear $1.01, Base $3.52, Bull $8.46. Verdict HOLD at $4.00 (watchlist for new money), maximum buy price $1.58.
